initial_run.follow_up: model SCLK_frequency and independent oracle SCLK_max_frequency incorrectly rejected nominal 20MHz

root_cause: For f=1e12/period_ps <=66.6e6, period_ps*66.6e6 must be >=1e12, not <=1e12. Initially both validators repeated the same wrong multiplication inequality.
fix: Model uses corrected integer multiplication; oracle now uses independent exact Fraction frequency division.
note: This was not a completed 23-test run or a silicon failure; initial failure retained instead of counted as passed.
